name: Code - OSS
description: VS Code 1.142.0 built from its MIT source (Code - OSS), with its server, extensions, terminal and git inside a VM: it sees only the folders you share with it, and reaches the internet only if you allow it. Two vCPUs make it noticeably faster.

folders.name: workspace
folders.purpose: The folder you work on: VS Code opens it at start and can read, change, create and delete files in it, as can the programs you run in its terminal.

devices.purpose: The Paste and Copy menu items, and pasting into the terminal (keyboard copy and paste in the editor work without it).
The Ports view: a server you start in the terminal (npm run dev, a preview) opens in your browser at localhost.

network.purpose: Git remotes, npm and pip, extensions and their icons, APIs you test: for the editor, its terminal and its window. Never your local network or this Mac.
